Interpreter – Arabic/Sudanese Arabic | IRC - International Rescue Committee Skip to main content Interpreter – Arabic/Sudanese Arabic IRC - International Rescue Committee Remote | Baltimore International Junior level Speaks Arabic, English Apply Summary by Impactpool The International Rescue Committee (IRC) is seeking an Arabic/Sudanese Arabic Interpreter to provide accurate and confidential interpretation services for Limited English Proficient (LEP) individuals. The role involves in-person and remote interpretation in various settings, tracking assignments, and participating in trainings. Candidates should have a high school diploma, relevant interpretation experience, and cultural sensitivity. This position offers a chance to make a significant impact in the lives of individuals affected by humanitarian crises. Candidate Requirements: High school diploma preferred Interpretation certification preferred Relevant professional interpretation experience preferred Experience with refugee/immigrant populations preferred Cultural sensitivity Proficient in English Spoken proficiency in Arabic Attention to detail Basic computer skills Reliable transportation The International Rescue Committee (IRC) responds to the world's worst humanitarian crises, helping to restore health, safety, education, economic wellbeing, and power to people devastated by conflict and disaster. Founded in 1933 at the call of Albert Einstein, the IRC is one of the world's largest international humanitarian non-governmental organizations (INGO), at work in more than 40 countries and 29 U.S. cities helping people to survive, reclaim control of their future and strengthen their communities. A force for humanity, IRC employees deliver lasting impact by restoring safety, dignity and hope to millions. If you're a solutions-driven, passionate change-maker, come join us in positively impacting the lives of millions of people world-wide for a better future. This job posting was opened on 3/28/25. Please note that we will be prioritizing candidates who are current IRC (and recently employed by IRC) staff before other applicants. If necessary, we will extend the opportunity to external candidates.
Job Overview: The Arabic/ Sudanese Arabic Interpreter provides in-person and/or remote interpretation to facilitate, with accuracy, impartiality, and confidentiality, the language needs of Limited English Proficient (LEP) individuals and their service providers. Activities include providing professional interpretation services, use of software to track assignments, and occasional trainings and assessments.Major Responsibilities:Responsibilities include, but are not limited to:
• Provide accurate, impartial, and confidential interpretation to LEP individuals and service providers in a variety of settings, including clinics, hospitals, schools, community-based organizations, and government agencies. Services may be rendered in-person, via telephone, videoconference, or other virtual means.
• Track

deep_read.title: Arabic Translator
deep_read.description: Job Purpose The Arabic Translator is responsible for providing accurate, professional, and culturally appropriate translation services between Arabic and English for official documents, correspondence, reports, policies, regulations, technical materials, presentations, and communication materials within the Department of Municipality & Transportation. The role ensures consistency of terminology, linguistic quality, and effective communication while supporting regulatory compliance, stakeholder engagement, and organizational objectives. Key Responsibilities Translation Services Translate a wide range of documents from Arabic to English and English to Arabic while maintaining accuracy, clarity, and context. Translate official correspondence, reports, contracts, policies, procedures, technical specifications, presentations, and public communications. Ensure translations are linguistically correct, professionally written, and culturally appropriate. Maintain consistency in terminology and language usage across all translated materials. Technical Translation Translate engineering, transportation, infrastructure, urban planning, municipal, and regulatory documents. Review technical documents to ensure accurate interpretation of specialized terminology. Coordinate with subject matter experts to verify technical content when necessary. Develop and maintain technical terminology databases and glossaries. Editing & Proofreading Proofread translated documents for grammar, syntax, spelling, formatting, and consistency. Review and edit translations completed by external translators or service providers. Conduct quality assurance checks before final submission. Ensure all translated documents meet organizational standards and requirements. Linguistic Quality Control Maintain consistency in translation style, terminology, and formatting. Ensure language quality complies with organizational communication standards. Update translation references and terminology resources regularly. Recommend improvements to translation processes and standards. Documentation & Records Management Maintain records of translated documents and translation requests. Organize and archive translation files and reference materials. Ensure confidentiality and secure handling of sensitive information and official documents. Track translation assignments and deadlines to ensure timely delivery. Stakeholder Support Provide language support to internal departments and project teams. Assist in preparing bilingual communication materials and presentations. Support meetings, workshops, and stakeholder engagements requiring translation assistance. Respond to requests for translation services within agreed service levels. Compliance & Governance Ensure translated materials comply with government regulations, organizational policies, and legal requirements. Support the implementation of official language standards.
